qa_observations:
1. **GraphicRiver was fully blocked (403 on all direct fetches).** All GraphicRiver findings rely solely on Google search index snippets and are classified as blocked_url_index_verified or could_not_verify. Price data lacked proper continuous verbatim passages and was excluded.
2. **Envato Elements was fully blocked (403 on all direct fetches).** All Envato Elements findings rely on Google search index snippets. Specific dollar pricing was available only through third-party articles (secondary retelling) and was excluded per Edge case 2.
3. **CodeCanyon pages returned 200 status codes but rendered incomplete content due to JavaScript dependency.** Detailed content (category counts, product listings, sorting options) was supplemented from Google search index snippets and classified as blocked_url_index_verified.
4. **ThemeForest and AudioJungle provided the most reliable direct access.** Category pages and browse pages were fully fetched and rendered, providing high-confidence clean findings.
5. **No Envato-specific third-party auxiliary tools were identified (SD-15).** All marketplace optimization tools found in search results target Amazon, eBay, Walmart, or Shopify ecosystems. The only Envato-ecosystem tooling identified was Envato's own Market API (F-P13) and author SEO guidance in their help center.
6. **Sales figures on the ThemeForest /top-sellers page (F-02, F-03, F-04) appear to represent weekly or recent-period sales** based on the page's "This week" period selector context, but the time period is not explicitly labeled next to individual sales counts.
7. **Category item counts are dynamic.** The ThemeForest subagent noted slight differences in sales/review counts for the same product between different pages (e.g., Avada showing "1.0504M Sales" on /category/all vs. "1.0559M Sales" on /category/wordpress), reflecting real-time updates. All findings cite data as observed at access time.
8. **No findings were upgraded under ambiguity.** All borderline cases were degraded to provisional or excluded per the Degradation Rule.
9. **11-point QA was applied to each finding before inclusion.** Findings with contextual qualifiers not present in verbatim, multi-source contamination, or insufficient verbatim evidence were excluded or degraded.
